name: GIF Search
shortDescription: Search and copy GIFs inside BTT Launcher.
description: A native BetterTouchTool Launcher plugin with GIPHY GIFs, KLIPY GIFs/Stickers/Memes, keyless Wikimedia Commons GIF search, animated previews, favorites, recents, and keyboard navigation.
requirements: Internet connection for online providers, saved-provider refreshes, and media
Your own GIPHY API key / KLIPY app key for the corresponding providers
Apple Command Line Tools if requested by BetterTouchTool for compilation
Wikimedia Commons public search needs no API key or account; individual file licenses apply.
installation: Drag GIFSearchLauncherPlugin.swift onto BetterTouchTool preferences and approve compilation/loading.
Configure your own GIPHY API key / KLIPY app key in Launcher Settings → GIF Search → API Keys.
Open BTT Launcher, search for GIF Search, and open the result.
limitations: Animation and media paste support depend on the receiving application.
Some stickers and memes are static PNG images.
Provider keys, account permissions, quotas, internet access, and content availability affect results.
GIPHY/KLIPY return up to 50 items per page; choosing 100 uses two requests. Commons returns up to 50 items and requires a search phrase.
Favorites and Recent store references, not offline media copies.
Media downloads are limited to 32 MiB. Timeouts and restricted redirects can prevent downloads.
Provider keys are stored in ordinary BetterTouchTool configuration fields, not Keychain.
Individual media licenses and provider terms apply.
